title: Hebrews Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Hebrews 7: Melchizedek who met Abraham, the change of priesthood, and the priest who lives forever.

questions.text: Melchizedek is called king of which place?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 calls Melchizedek king of Salem and priest of God Most High.

questions.text: What was Abraham returning from when Melchizedek met him?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says Melchizedek met Abraham as he was returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him.

questions.text: According to verse 2, what does "king of Salem" mean by interpretation?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says he is first "king of righteousness", and then also "king of Salem", which means "king of peace".

questions.text: What did Abraham give to Melchizedek?
questions.explanation: Verses 2 and 4 say Abraham divided a tenth part of all to him, giving a tenth out of the best plunder.

answers.text: A field with a cave in it
All the flocks that he owned
A tenth out of the best plunder

questions.text: What does verse 7 say happens without any dispute?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says that without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.

answers.text: The lesser is blessed by the greater
The greater is blessed by the lesser
The priest is blessed by the people
Every man blesses his own household

questions.text: Out of which tribe does the text say our Lord has sprung?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, a tribe about which Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

questions.text: After what has this priest been made, according to verse 16?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says he has been made not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life.

answers.text: The law of a fleshly commandment
The power of an endless life

questions.text: In the oath quoted in verse 21, what will the Lord not do?
questions.explanation: Verse 21 quotes: "The Lord swore and will not change his mind, 'You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.'"

questions.text: Why is he able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him?
questions.explanation: Verses 24 and 25 say that because he lives forever his priesthood is unchangeable, and he lives forever to make intercession for them.

answers.text: Because he lives forever to make intercession
Because he offers sacrifices every day
Because the law has been made perfect

questions.text: How often did he offer up himself, according to verse 27?
questions.explanation: Verse 27 says he does not need to offer sacrifices daily like those high priests, for he did this once for all when he offered up himself.
